answer.label: system-prompted
answer.justification: The layer-2 spike of 61.9 sits inside the system-prompted range (31.7 – 64.0), while quantized (0.8 – 2.8) and fine-tuned (0.7 – 6.1) are far below it. The relative L2 profile also fits: it climbs steeply to 0.294 at layer 8, plateaus at 0.409 at layer 16 and 24, and ends at 0.451 at layer 32. Final-layer cosine similarity of 0.877 is in the system-prompted range (0.848 – 0.900), and direction consistency of 0.534 matches (0.530 – 0.539), unlike the fine-tuned range (0.618 – 0.705). The mid-layer size ratio of 0.975 is slightly below 1, as expected for system-prompted and not for fine-tuned (above 1). Effective rank of 2.94 and layer-1 L2 of 0.153 are slightly outside the ranges, and onset layer 9 is just past 7 – 8, but the layer-2 spike and plateau shape rule out the other categories. Output and logit levels were not available.
